sources.license: All rights reserved (no redistribution licence granted)
sources.notes: DISABLED for legal reasons: dayinhistory.dev publishes no licence for its data ('All rights reserved'; content is AI-refined), its free tier is for 'personal projects and learning' and it is limited to 10 requests/hour per IP. Do not enable it for a public dataset without written permission or a suitable plan. Opt in explicitly with `--sources dayinhistory`. If enabled, only the events endpoint is fetched; add "births"/"deaths" URLs to extra_endpoints for more.

sources.name: Wikimedia Featured Feed (Did you know)
sources.notes: Only today/upcoming dates have a dyk array (absent for past dates), so it is fetched only within output.did_you_know.fetch_window_days of today (UTC); other days use the heuristic extractor in scripts/fun_fact_extractor.py.

legal.disclaimer: Best-effort compliance information, not legal advice.
legal.attribution_suffix: Compiled and adapted by the Higle datasource project (https://github.com/ymchandra/higle-datasource); changes were made. Not endorsed by the Wikimedia Foundation. Images are linked, not included; each image keeps its own licence (see image_credit).
legal.modifications: Entries were selected, normalised (HTML removed, years parsed, headline titles shortened to about 100 characters with an ellipsis), merged and de-duplicated across sources, ranked, capped per day and category, and sorted. Summaries keep the source wording. did_you_know facts are either Wikipedia "Did you know" hooks (text only, reformatted) or one-sentence rewordings of existing entries (prefixed with the date, possibly shortened). Image links are unmodified Wikimedia URLs.
legal.image_policy: Only images hosted on upload.wikimedia.org or thumb.wikimedia.org under /wikipedia/commons/ whose Wikimedia Commons licence is Public domain, CC0, CC BY or CC BY-SA are kept; everything else is dropped. Author, licence and the Commons file page are recorded in image_credit.
